፶፱: ፶፱ — 59, spoken ኀምሳ ወተስዐቱ (ḫämsa wä-täsʿatu) 'fifty-nine'; chapter number (numeral)
ሐተቶ: ሐተተ — he questioned him, examined him (3ms perfect, G, ḥ-t-t + -ኦ '3ms him'; the object is named after it by ለ-, ለግብጻዊ)
ለግብጻዊ: ግብጻዊ — the Egyptian (ለ- marking the object, doubling the suffix of ሐተቶ; ግብጽ 'Egypt' + the adjectival ending -ዊ)
ወረከበ: ረከበ — and he found (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, r-k-b)
እመኳንንተ: መኰንን — from among the governors (እም- + plural መኳንንት, construct 'governors of')
ዘለአኮ: ለአከ — whom he sent (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ለአከ + -ኦ 'him', written ለአኮ)
ወምሉእ: ምሉእ — and full, filled (ወ- + adjective, passive participle of መልአ 'be full')
ወአፍጠኖ: አፍጠነ — and he hastened (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ፈጠነ 'be quick', + -ኦ 'him', the object of the following infinitive ሐቲተ)
የሀብ: ወሀበ — he gives (3ms imperfect/jussive, G, w-h-b; after ዘእንበለ)
ወመልእክቶ: መልእክት — and his message (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', written -ቶ)
ይግዕዙ: ገዐዘ — they go away, depart, travel (3mp imperfect after እንዘ, G, g-ʿ-z) (?)
ለአከኒ: ለአከ — he sent me (3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
ኣየድዐከ: አይድዐ — I will make known to you, tell you (1cs imperfect አየድዕ + -ከ '2ms to you'; root y-d-ʿ 'know'; the first-order ኣ- is as printed) (?)
ቦእኩ: ቦአ — I entered (1cs perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ቃህራ: ቃህራ — Cairo (proper name, from Arabic al-Qāhira) (?)
ሀገሩ: ሀገር — his city, 'the city of' (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለንጉሥ)
ወበብጽሐትየ: ብጽሐት — and at my arrival (ወ- + በ- 'in, at' + verbal noun of በጽሐ + -የ '1cs my')
ይነፍሑ: ነፍሐ — they blow (3mp imperfect, G, n-f-ḥ)
በዕንዚራት: ዕንዚራ — with harps (?) (በ- + plural ዕንዚራት; a stringed instrument, 'harp' by convention in the published parts; here governed by ነፍሐ 'blow', which would suit a wind instrument) (?)
ወይረውጹ: ሮጸ — and they run, race (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, r-w-ṣ)
በሰረገላት: ሰረገላ — in carts, chariots (በ- + plural ሰረገላት; 'cart' is the published parts' rendering for the Ethiopians' vehicle)
ሰማያዊያን: ሰማያዊ — heavenly ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
ርእይዎሙ: ርእየ — they saw them (3mp perfect ርእዩ + -ዎሙ '3mp them', G, r-ʾ-y)
ይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — they said to them (3mp perfect ይቤሉ + -ዎሙ 'to them', b-h-l)
እሉሰ: እሉ — as for these, these indeed (demonstrative pl. + emphatic -ሰ)
ይጠብብ: ጠበበ — he is wise (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-b-b)
እምሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — than Solomon (እም- comparative 'more than' + proper name)
ኢሖረ: ሖረ — he did not go, travel (ኢ- negative + 3ms perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ወማኅፈድ: ማኅፈድ — and tower (?) (ወ- + noun; 'tower' in the published parts, here a building of the idols, a temple tower or precinct) (?)
ቦኡ: ቦአ — they entered (3mp perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ወተሰብሩ: ተሰብረ — and they were broken (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt passive of ሰበረ)
ወአማልክተ: አምላክ — and gods of (ወ- + plural አማልክት, construct)
ተቀጥቀጡ: ተቀጥቀጠ — they were crushed, shattered (3mp perfect, passive of quadriliteral ቀጥቀጠ)
ገነውተ: ገነውት (?) — servants, priests of the gods (noun, plural, construct 'servants-of'; the singular and so the dictionary form are uncertain, behind it a verb ገነወ 'to serve, worship' (?))
ማርያነ: ማርያን (?) — ማርያን (?) of Egypt (noun, plural, construct ማርያነ; unidentified — perhaps 'leaders, elders', perhaps a class of priests or diviners) (?)
ዘወድቁ: ወድቀ — that they fell (ዘ- + 3mp perfect, G; ዘ- as 'the fact that' after በእንተ)
ወበእንተዝኬ: በእንተዝ — and therefore, for this reason (ወ- + በእንተ + ዝ 'this' + -ኬ)
ትበውእ: ቦአ — she enters (3fs imperfect, G, b-w-ʾ; ታቦት as subject)
ዘይመስላ: መሰለ — who resembles her/it (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect ይመስል + -ኣ 'her')
ለጥበብከ: ጥበብ — to your wisdom (ለ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your'; 'equal to your wisdom')
ወሀብከ: ወሀበ — you gave (2ms perfect, G, w-h-b)
ዘአንጽሑ: አንጽሐ — which they sanctified, made clean (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, causative of ነጽሐ 'be clean, pure'; no object suffix — the object is the antecedent of ዘ-)
ንሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — we hear (1cp imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
ታድኅነክሙ: አድኀነ — she saves you (3fs imperfect + -ክሙ '2mp you', causative)
ወመንፈሰ: መንፈስ — and spirit of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ይትናገረክሙ: ተናገረ — he/it speaks to you (3ms imperfect, T-stem of ነገረ 'to tell', + -ክሙ '2mp to you')
ወአምላከ: አምላክ — and God of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ሰማይኒአ: ሰማይ — of heaven also (noun + the enclitic -ኒ 'also'; the final -አ is unexplained, a stray addition as in ወሀበነአ, ch. 36) (?)
ወትሰመዩ: ተሰምየ — and you are called (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, Gt passive of ሰምየ)
ዘወሀብክሙ: ወሀበ — that you gave (ዘ- + 2mp perfect, G, w-h-b)

__broaden__.ወማኅፈደ: ማኅፈድ — and tower (?) of (ወ- + noun, construct; 'stature' in ch. 31 is its figurative sense) (?) · here ማኅፈደ ጣዖታት 'the tower of the idols', a building of the idols, a temple tower or precinct (?)
